propositions: Closing a bug ticket produces repeated 'Ambiguous prefix' error lines on stderr during post-close caused_by derivation when commit subjects contain bare four-hex fragments matching multiple tickets.

The caused_by derivation re-resolves the bug_id and commit-subject candidates on every commit in the branch history without memoization, causing O(commits × tickets) alias-scanning work that hangs the post-write process for minutes despite the close having already committed durably.
The four-hex bare-prefix form is deprecated as a recommended reference form per operator decision; docs must stop advertising it while preserving backward-compatibility resolution.

The blame.py module must pass quiet=True at all scanner call sites and short-circuit resolution for hex-quad forms when the target's canonical id does not start with that prefix, eliminating both the ambiguity noise and the unbounded work.
